intent: Find caller's newest open basket, verify all items are available today and store is open, and if ready check it out via the payments workflow.
success_criteria: Caller identity resolved to a customer_id via /bin/id
Newest open basket for that customer selected (basket_status='open', max basket_created_at)
Readiness computed: store is_open=1 AND every basket item has available_today_quantity >= requested_quantity
Checkout performed via payments tool only when readiness is true; otherwise no payment created and reason reported
Checkout policy doc cited as grounding reference
Answer includes <YES>/<NO> readiness token and full repo path of the matched basket

args: WITH newest AS (SELECT basket_id, store_id, record_path, basket_created_at FROM shopping_baskets WHERE customer_id = :customer_id AND basket_status = 'open' ORDER BY basket_created_at DESC LIMIT 1) SELECT n.basket_id, n.store_id, n.record_path AS basket_path, n.basket_created_at, s.is_open, bi.line_number, bi.product_sku, bi.requested_quantity, COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity, 0) AS available_today_quantity, (s.is_open = 1 AND COALESCE(si.available_today_quantity,0) >= bi.requested_quantity) AS line_ready FROM newest n JOIN stores s ON s.store_id = n.store_id JOIN shopping_basket_items bi ON bi.basket_id = n.basket_id LEFT JOIN store_inventory si ON si.store_id = n.store_id AND si.product_sku = bi.product_sku ORDER BY bi.line_number;

agents_md_constraints.rule: When you apply a policy from `docs`, include that policy document as a grounding reference in the final response.
When answering yes/no questions - include <YES> or <NO> tokens in the response.
When responding with reference - provide full path in the repo to the object.
When starting work, make sure to run tree -L 2 on docs folder. It also makes sense to pull current date and id context

answer_template.message: Identity: {identity}. Newest open basket: {basket_readiness[0].basket_path}. Readiness today (store open + all items available_today >= requested): {basket_readiness all line_ready}. If ready: checked out -> {checkout_result}. <YES>/<NO> per checkout policy.
